name: model exposes raw logits
test:
import torch
model = BinaryMLP(3, 5)
logits = model(torch.randn(4, 3))
assert logits.shape == (4, 1)
assert (logits < 0).any() or (logits > 1).any()

name: accuracy uses one sigmoid and handles label shapes
test:
import torch
logits = torch.tensor([[-2.0], [0.0], [3.0]])
assert binary_accuracy(logits, torch.tensor([0., 0., 1.])) == 1.0
assert binary_accuracy(logits, torch.tensor([[0.], [0.], [1.]])) == 1.0

name: full batch training improves a separable set
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(14)
x = torch.tensor([[-2., -1.], [-1., -2.], [1., 2.], [2., 1.]])
y = torch.tensor([0., 0., 1., 1.])
model, loss, accuracy = train_binary_mlp(x, y, hidden_dim=4, lr=0.2, epochs=80)
assert isinstance(loss, float) and isinstance(accuracy, float)
assert model(x).shape == (4, 1)
assert accuracy >= 0.99 and loss < 0.2
